script: The US government hid an entire city from the people living inside it. In 1942, Oak Ridge, Tennessee appeared on no public map, guarded behind fences, home to seventy five thousand workers who had no idea what they were building. Officials told them only to turn dials and record numbers, nothing more, ever. Most workers spent years enriching uranium without knowing the word uranium, let alone what it was for. Wives raised children in a city that technically did not exist, mail address and all. Only a handful of scientists at the very top understood the full picture. In August 1945, the atomic bomb dropped on Hiroshima, and workers finally learned what their own hands had built. The US government hid an entire city, and let its own residents build a weapon blind.
